decisions.reason: The deadline applies to completing the reference-matching qualification clip; it does not change the established submission channel or submission content.
The task-local deadline for the qualification clip does not alter the separate monthly quota of 125 approved clips.
Completing the corrective qualification clip today does not change the deferred Lead Clipper role, its pathway, training, or responsibilities.
The source sets a completion deadline but does not modify any caption color, font, or effects standard.
The source changes only the qualification submission timing and leaves the clean-editing and effects constraints unchanged.
The deadline does not change the permitted source, topic constraint, or batch source constraint for trial clips.
The source establishes when the qualification clip should be completed but does not alter its required duration.
The completion deadline does not modify the requirement that a clip contain a complete standalone lesson or story.
The source sets timing for the corrective clip without changing the standard for selecting strong or impactful moments.
